question: Does the s033-s034-s035 density+polish chain generalise to representative cohort seeds 23/57/28?
hypothesis: The density+polish chain produces Band A-or-B candidates on the cohort-representative pilot seeds as it did on seed 89.
narrative_md: The density+polish chain does NOT generalise: 0/3 pilot seeds produce Band A-or-B. Two failure modes — phi-sweep ICs too far from truth (seed 23: rho=50 start -> LM diverges) and narrow basin unreachable (seed 28: 0 survivors); seed 57 timed out (49% bracket). Phi-sweep IC primitive is the architectural bottleneck (seed-dependent off-circle floor). Points to Sobol-Shoemake q0 ICs as the robust replacement (s037).
